title: Tableclock: a multi-device turn timer / N-player chess clock for board-game tables
user: Board-game groups and parents with analysis-paralysis players who want a 3–8 player clock that survives OS updates and works on whatever phones are at the table.
smallest_useful_product: Add 2–8 players, choose count-up, bank, Fischer increment, or fixed per-turn, then tap to end turns. The clock uses large colour fields, audio/vibration cues, flexible order, optional room sync, and URL presets.
constraints: Local-first; iOS wake-lock limitations; server-authoritative timestamps when a sync service is configured; no accounts or game trademarks.
